title: Depop Product Scraper
description: Collect structured public Depop listings from a search URL or keyword, with sorting and cursor pagination.

url.title: Depop search URL
url.description: A Depop search, localized search, category, or filtered search URL. When provided, URL filters are preserved and the URL takes priority over keyword.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search phrase used when URL is empty, for example jersey, vintage Nike, or leather bag.

country.title: Country storefront
country.description: Optional storefront country. A country in a localized URL takes priority when this field is empty.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of listing records to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of API pages to request. Each page contains up to 24 listings.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy configuration. Residential routing is recommended for protected storefronts.
